top_strength: Danah delivered a clear, accurate, itemized pricing breakdown and confidently handled Brandon's repeated follow-up questions on rate, trip fee, and packing cost without losing her place, leaving him satisfied enough to call Einstein his "number one pick."
coaching_note: With a warm, ready-to-book customer on the line, Danah never attempted to lock in the August 5th date, skipped the Save Your Ass prep speech entirely, and left out No Worries coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, and the email follow-up - all of which would have moved this from a quote call to a booked move.
phone_presence_notes: Polite and responsive throughout, but exchanges lean transactional - frequent short acknowledgments ("Mm-hmm," "Yup") with little explicit warmth, empathy, or affirmation despite the customer ending the call clearly satisfied.
